title.en: An Act to Provide Emergency Fund for Elementary Classes, to Regulate the Expenditure Thereof, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of seven hundred seventy-six thousand six hundred seventy-five pesos to be expended
for the reopening of elementary classes which were in operation in the various municipalities during the
month of March, nineteen hundred and thirty-five, but which had to be closed or may not have opened at the
beginning of the current school year due to lack of funds. This sum shall be distributed in the discretion of the
Secretary of Public Instruction to the various municipalities concerned: Provided, That no municipality shall
receive from this sum any amount in excess of what is actually required to put its elementary classes into full
operation until December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and thirty-five.

Any balance of the amount authorized in the preceding section remaining unallotted on
December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and thirty-five, shall revert to the Insular Treasury.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 13, 1935.
